about_the_game:
Demo? is that some sort of sibling of Nebo? anyway, enjoy this short demo for Rinny Platformer Rage Game! explore (in what you can) a short world with a story that serves as a prequel to the series Pretty Blood which doesn't take itself too seriously, at times, so you shouldn't either! remember, this is just a demo, so stay tuned for more!
All you're given to work with is merely section 0 and a tad bit of section 1 to play, section 0 being the shortest when it comes to finished sections of the game. But for now... on section 0 you play as Azra, a lovely lady from a species discovered by humans named "Malinos", who went to work without knowing that someone she trusted was going to do something horrible to her, damaging her psyche and leading to the events of section 1. Which speaking of, here, you play as the lovely, totally not a psychopath, Rinny, a malino who is Azra's wife and a crazed psychopath (okay i lied about the "totally not a psychopath" part, my bad :<) who got hit by a rock by a robot called T.O.T.G, Who searches to encapsulate all of Rinny's city and take down Rinny herself in the process, do you think you're up to the challenge? or will you give up and close the game?

playtime:

~20-50 mins

Trigger Warnings:

  • Gore

  • Use of nicotine

  • Depictions of mutilation, kidnapping, etc.

  • Foul language

  • Flashing lights

  • Depictions of self harm/suicide

Neither RBIE or Santu1423 is responsible if you're sensitive to any of these topics and decide to play the game anyway

NOTE: the "Platformer Rage" in the logo is smaller because they only really apply to section 1, after that every section will have more of the "Rinny" and "Game" part tbh, some parts in following sections WILL have platformer sectors, but it definitely will lose the "Rage" part.
